page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmgn8ia.64xlarge is an x86_64 bare-metal compute-optimized server equipped with specialized graphics acceleration. The platform is powered by dual AMD EPYC 9T34 processors delivering 256 dedicated vCPUs running at a clock speed of 3.4 GHz. System memory is scaled to 1536 GB, yielding an allocation of 6.0 GB RAM per vCPU. Hardware acceleration is provided by four NVIDIA L20 Ada Lovelace GPUs, supplying a total of 192 GB of GPU VRAM across the system.

Network connectivity features a high-throughput baseline bandwidth of 160 Gbps, managed under the KVM hypervisor architecture. The instance does not include bundled local disk storage, which necessitates network-attached storage or remote object storage for persistent data requirements. The configuration emphasizes massive parallel computational capacity over integrated localized disk I/O.

From an architectural standpoint, the combination of 256 dedicated high-frequency cores, 1.5 TB of memory, and quad L20 accelerators yields high compute and accelerator density within a single node. This resource concentration favors distributed machine learning inference, deep learning validation, video transcoding, visual computing, and large-scale parallel data processing tasks requiring massive aggregate memory and high inter-node communication bandwidth.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmgn8ia.64xlarge is a high-density, GPU-accelerated bare-metal server instance designed for compute-intensive workloads. Built on the x86_64 architecture, it incorporates 256 dedicated AMD EPYC 9T34 vCPUs running at a clock rate of 3.4 GHz, complemented by 1536 GB of system RAM offering 6.0 GB per virtual processor. Hardware acceleration is delivered via four NVIDIA L20 Ada Lovelace GPUs supplying a combined 192 GB of video memory. The platform operates on a KVM hypervisor and integrates 160 Gbps of baseline networking capacity to support dense communication across distributed clusters. It does not include local disk storage, requiring external or networked storage solutions for persistent storage operations. Given its extensive processing core count, multi-GPU architecture, and high memory footprint, ecs.ebmgn8ia.64xlarge is positioned for distributed machine learning inference, deep learning model evaluation, video processing, and enterprise scientific computing jobs.
